title: OCTOBER.
body: New season, new rhythm. As El Paso cools down, your skin starts asking for something different — more moisture, more care, a little more you-time. This month at Solace Skin Lab we're all about calm, glowing, fall-ready skin.

title: DRY AIR, TIGHT SKIN?
body: El Paso's fall air pulls moisture right out of your skin. Three easy fixes: 1) swap foaming cleansers for a gentle cream cleanser, 2) layer a hydrating serum under your moisturizer, 3) never skip SPF — the sun is still strong here.
cta: Save this for your next skincare restock.
imageScene: Macro close-up of a woman's cheek with dewy hydrated skin, a drop of serum from a glass dropper, warm copper backlight.

title: THE "11s"
imageSub: Why they show up — and what helps
